title: Small-bound factor-base optimization
objective: Optimize exact BDF interval logarithms and select theorem-safe small Minkowski factor bases in auto mode

handoff.summary: Uses exact integer anchoring for tight rational log intervals, reducing the discriminant-minus59 cubic's cold BDF certification from 8.18 seconds to 1.59 seconds with the same strict bound 7. Auto and explicit GRH selection now return a fresh assumption-free Minkowski bound when its exact integral-norm floor is at most the conditional search minimum 2; this field's complete factor base falls from two primes and 8.4 seconds to one prime and 0.12 seconds without polynomial special-casing. Tests replay the anchored interval outward construction, overlap it with direct endpoint logs, preserve the BDF oracle, and prove BDF is not entered by the unconditional shortcut. The full class-unit engine suite also passes 28/28 with the narrower bases and log-rank continuation policy.
risks: Selecting the smaller unconditional base changes deterministic factor-base fingerprints and invalidates checkpoints made with the former BDF plan; greenfield policy permits the direct correction.

Legacy certified_minkowski_class_bound reports the ceiling 3 for this field, while factor-base generation correctly uses the integral-norm floor 2; downstream proofs must bind the factor-base theorem record rather than substitute the legacy ceiling.
The mandatory pnpm test:native gate remains pending for central integration as directed.
next_steps: Integration should retain the exact FactorBaseBound cutoff and assumptions in class-number proof certificates.
Central integration owns broad native and full class-unit end-to-end gates.
